item.title: Agent CI/CD Eval Pipeline Integration Guide 2026
item.description: Agent CI/CD in 2026 requires five evaluation gates that don’t exist in traditional pipelines: golden dataset offline eval, regression blocks, cost gates, shadow evaluation against production traces, and canary rollout with auto-rollback. If you’re shipping agent updates against only lint and unit tests, you’re shipping blind — 89% of production agent teams run observability but only 52% run evals, and that 37-point gap is where quality silently decays (LangChain State of Agent Engineering Survey, 2026).
